title: Bully
shortDescription: Rockstar's satirical boarding-school open-world following rebellious student Jimmy Hopkins at Bullworth Academy.
historicalSignificance: Praised for its tightly contained social simulation, witty period satire, and memorable prep school atmosphere.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
